id: # dmeshflow: the device meshing path's transfer (engine/meshfeed.c, cuda/mesh/cumesh.c)

cause: a mesh feed carried over frames nobody took (play draws between its dumped shots) could hold two uploads into one band or chunk slot, and cumesh_copy runs one block an upload in parallel, so the slot kept whichever block wrote last (never seen to fail: the later upload is usually the only one a request reads); a later upload of a slot in the same feed now turns the earlier ones into MF_SKIP
